invariants.statement: Cloud Mode is one logical product. Desktop Cloud, Web, and Mobile Cloud share identical backend behavior — fix shared backend once; never fork behavior per surface.
Local Mode is completely isolated and never talks to AGI Cloud (no telemetry, sync, or provider proxy).
BYOK exists only in Local Mode, with no markup. Web/Mobile v1 expose no BYOK.
Desktop Local and Mobile Local store everything locally. Local data leaves the device only via an explicit, consented transfer.
Stacks are fixed: Desktop = Rust/Tauri; Mobile = Expo/React Native; Web = Next.js; backend = Neon + Clerk.
Shared packages/ and crates/ are the preferred implementation point. Platform-specific code is the justified exception.
Billing is subscription-first. Tokens pass through at cost; monetize the software/governance layer.
Multi-provider is core; no provider lock-in. Model IDs/capabilities come from packages/types/src/models.json.
Trust boundaries are a product invariant. Local->BYOK->Managed is never crossed silently; a violation is P0.

rules.statement: Never duplicate business logic. Prefer shared packages/ and crates/; a second copy needs an explicit removal plan.
rules.rationale: Six surfaces re-implementing similar flows causes surface drift; defining behavior once is also the scaling strategy.

rules.statement: Fix the shared backend before platform-specific code. Platform code adapts to the shared contract, not vice versa.
rules.rationale: Cloud Mode is one logical product (INV-1); forking behavior per surface breaks parity.

rules.statement: Cross-surface verification: if Mobile Cloud changes a shared API, verify Desktop Cloud + Web; if the backend changes, verify all Cloud surfaces.
rules.rationale: Shared backend behavior must stay identical across Cloud surfaces (INV-1).
rules.enforced_by: dependency_graph.json verification_rules, per-surface checks in commands.json

rules.statement: Every feature has runtime validation — validate all tool/LLM/API/IPC inputs (Zod/serde); no unvalidated external input.
rules.rationale: Unvalidated external input is a recurring LLM-failure class and a security exposure.

rules.statement: Every bug requires reproduction -> root cause -> fix -> regression test -> verification. No fix lands without a regression test.
rules.rationale: Prevents silent regressions; regression tests caught the AutoEconomy routing regression.

rules.statement: No speculative refactors during Alpha stabilization. Refactor only what the active increment touches.
rules.rationale: Stabilization phase prioritizes shipping the active surface over breadth.

rules.statement: Adapt, never copy proprietary (Operating Law 3); verify before done (Operating Law 4); no theater (Operating Law 5).
rules.rationale: Study claude-code for intent; port only from license-clean donors; no feature is complete on build success alone; no fake tests or claims beyond shipped scope.
